title: Universe Repair & Canonicalization
summary: momentum_events_canonical built (23,268 rows, exact). Instrument classification rebuilt on vendor reference data (Amendment 1) after the original 9-rule heuristic left 5.15% suspect-unresolved. Re-ingested 7 in-scope recovered folders; one (GTN.A_2025-06-12) had no quotes.parquet on disk, resolved by splitting coverage per-side (Amendment 2). The bivariate outlier fit surfaced 150 zero-event-day-trades events, traced to a real collector bug: collect_massive_data.py used the US federal holiday calendar instead of the exchange calendar, so Columbus Day/Veterans Day/Juneteenth-2021 events were never collected (142 of 150) and 1,849 in-scope windows (8.89%) carry session-shape damage (Amendment 3). Final in-scope universe: 20,802/23,268. Waterfall and folder-side accounting both balance to 0 residual. Dev sample v2 (50 events) built and verified as a strict main-table subset.

surprises: collect_massive_data.py used pandas' USFederalHolidayCalendar for session windows - it includes Columbus Day, Veterans Day, and (in 2021) Juneteenth's first observance, none of which are XNYS holidays.

33 in-scope events anchored exactly on Columbus Day 2025 have trades on the anchor day (unlike the 142-event pattern) - get_trading_window's date_range excludes a non-business-day center entirely, breaking the offset model; not root-caused further.
1,606 folders have a trades file but no quotes file, vs. the ~1,540 expected from prior context (diff 66 > 50 threshold) - noted, not investigated (Phase 4 owns it).
The T1 heuristic's catch-all 'common' class silently absorbed 114 fund_product and 27 preferred tickers it had no pattern for (e.g. all-caps-P preferred suffixes like APOpA).
